markers.name: Limgrave
markers.desc: The first major region in Elden Ring. An overcast domain scattered with hills and ruins.

markers.name: Liurnia of the Lakes
markers.desc: A country of lakes to the north of Limgrave, presided over by the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

markers.name: Altus Plateau
markers.desc: A golden plateau far above Liurnia. Known as the land of the Erdtree, with its royal capital Leyndell.

markers.name: Caelid
markers.desc: Vast scarlet wilds located to Limgrave's east, consummately marred by rot.

markers.name: Mountaintops of the Giants
markers.desc: A land of snow-covered mountains, beyond and above the realm of the Erdtree.
markers.image: File:ER Mountaintops of the Giants Stone Bridge Panorama (16.9).png

markers.name: Stranded Graveyard
markers.desc: A cave system below Limgrave and an unceremonious dumping site for Tarnished arrivals in the Lands Between.

markers.name: Stormhill
markers.desc: A windswept hill in northern Limgrave. Perched on top is Stormveil Castle.

markers.name: Weeping Peninsula
markers.desc: Limgrave's southern peninsula, named for its perpetual rainfall.

markers.name: Bellum Highway
markers.desc: A vast highway in northeastern Liurnia connecting the Academy to the Grand Lift of Dectus.

markers.name: Moonlight Altar
markers.desc: A prominent plateau in southern Liurnia, only accessible later on.

markers.name: Mt. Gelmir
markers.desc: A precipitous volcano on the western Altus Plateau, home to Volcano Manor.

markers.name: Capital Outskirts
markers.desc: Golden plains and battlefields surrounded by Leyndell's outermost wall.

markers.name: Swamp of Aeonia
markers.desc: An expansive swamp of scarlet rot in central Caelid.

markers.name: Wailing Dunes
markers.desc: A barren desert by the sea and the location of the Radahn festival.

markers.name: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
markers.desc: A plateau in northern Caelid where dragons nest.

markers.name: Forbidden Lands
markers.desc: A dark and foggy path connecting Leyndell to the Mountaintops of the Giants via the Grand Lift of Rold.

markers.name: Flame Peak
markers.desc: The highest point in all the Lands Between. Atop the mountain is the Forge of Giants.

markers.name: Consecrated Snowfield
markers.desc: A snowy expanse in the western Mountaintops and the final destination on the path to the Haligtree.

markers.name: Stormveil Castle
markers.desc: The sprawling stronghold of Godrick the Grafted, from which he presides over Limgrave.

markers.name: Academy of Raya Lucaria
markers.desc: A school of sorcery towering over Liurnia Lake.
markers.image: File:ER Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer Raya Lucaria.png

markers.name: Volcano Manor
markers.desc: A mansion and its surrounding town built into the caldera of Mount Gelmir. Headquarters of Praetor Rykard and his recusants.

markers.name: Leyndell, Royal Capital
markers.desc: The sprawling golden city at the foot of the Erdtree and the capital of the Golden Order's empire.

markers.name: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
markers.desc: A labyrinthine network of sewers and dungeons below the royal capital, accessed via a well in the lower city.

markers.name: Miquella's Haligtree
markers.desc: The withering holy tree to the north of the Mountaintops, Haligtree Town built into its canopy.

markers.name: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
markers.desc: The tiered city at the base of the Haligtree, accessed by descending through Haligtree Town.
markers.image: File:ER Legacy Dungeon Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.png

markers.name: Crumbling Farum Azula
markers.desc: A ruined city in the sky, crumbling since time immemorial.

markers.name: Castle Morne
markers.desc: A fortress in southern Limgrave at the very tip of the Weeping Peninsula, rattled by an uprising.

markers.name: Caria Manor
markers.desc: An estate in northwestern Liurnia belonging to the Carian Royal Family.

markers.name: The Shaded Castle
markers.desc: A derelict castle on the northern Altus Plateau. Found at the end of a valley festering with poisonous waters.

markers.name: Redmane Castle
markers.desc: The fortress of the Redmanes, on an island to the south of Caelid. This castle hosts the Radahn festival.

markers.name: Castle Sol
markers.desc: A mysterious, secluded castle in the north of the Mountaintops of the Giants. Found within is the Church of the Eclipse.

markers.name: Stormfoot Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs at the foot of Stormhill in Limgrave.

markers.name: Murkwater Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs at the northern end of the canyon carved by the Murkwater River in Limgrave.

markers.name: Deathtouched Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs touched by the Deathroot, found west of Saintsbridge in Limgrave.

markers.name: Impaler's Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs full of traps on the northeastern coast of the Weeping Peninsula.

markers.name: Tombsward Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs built into the northern side of the hill in Tombsward on the Weeping Peninsula.

markers.name: Cliffbottom Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs at the end of a cliffside path on the eastern coast of Liurnia.

markers.name: Road's End Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs at the end of a road to the west of the Minor Erdtree in western Liurnia.

markers.name: Black Knife Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs touched by the Deathroot, found at the end of a northbound road on the Eastern Tableland in Liurnia.

markers.name: Unsightly Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs sealed by an imp statue to the west of the Perfumer's Ruins on the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Wyndham Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs north of the ruins of Wyndham on the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Auriza Side Tomb
markers.desc: Catacombs opposite Auriza Hero's Grave along the valley road on the eastern Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Leyndell Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs found deep within the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below the capital Leyndell.

markers.name: Minor Erdtree Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs south of the Minor Erdtree in western Caelid.

markers.name: Caelid Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs southeast of the Cathedral of Dragon Communion, at the base of a cliff in Caelid.

markers.name: War-Dead Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs on the northeastern end of the Wailing Dunes in Caelid.

markers.name: Hidden Path to the Haligtree
markers.desc: Deathroot-touched catacombs leading to the Consecrated Snowfield, accessed by using the Haligtree Medallion at the Grand Lift of Rold.
markers.image: File:ER Hidden Path to the Haligtree.png

markers.name: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs touched by the Deathroot, built under a hill path north of Zamor in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.name: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
markers.desc: Catacombs along the southeastern edge of the Consecrated Snowfield in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.name: Fringefolk Hero's Grave
markers.desc: A dangerous catacomb connected to the Stranded Graveyard, sealed behind an imp statue seal.
markers.image: File:ER Poison Swamp Fringefolk Hero's Grave.png

markers.name: Sainted Hero's Grave
markers.desc: A crypt at the end of the ridge road on the Altus Plateau. It is host to shadow-cloaked enemies.

markers.name: Gelmir Hero's Grave
markers.desc: A lava-filled crypt on Mt. Gelmir with chariots patrolling the tunnels.

markers.name: Auriza Hero's Grave
markers.desc: A crypt at the end of the valley road on the eastern Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
markers.desc: A crypt in the southwestern Mountaintops of the Giants. It can only be accessed by ascending Flame Peak and jumping a gap between two plateaus.

markers.name: Cave of Knowledge
markers.article: A cave system in the Stranded Graveyard acting as the tutorial area for Elden Ring. New skills are put to the test by the Soldier of Godrick.

markers.name: Groveside Cave
markers.desc: A wolf-filled cave to the north of the Church of Elleh in Limgrave. At the end is a Beastman of Farum Azula.

markers.name: Coastal Cave
markers.desc: A cave system on the western coast of Ligmrave that connects the mainland to the Dragon Communion island. The way is blocked by a duo of Demi-Human Chiefs and their tribe.

markers.name: Murkwater Cave
markers.desc: A cave on the western bank of the Murkwater River in Limgrave, north of Lake Agheel. Deep within is the hideaway of Patches.

markers.name: Highroad Cave
markers.desc: A river cave at the northern terminus of Murkwater River in Limgrave. Traversing down through the buried Ancient Ruins leads to a hibernating Guardian Golem.

markers.name: Earthbore Cave
markers.desc: A cave in the cliffs of the northern coast of the Weeping Peninsula. The path to it is shown by the spirit who appears when interacting with a phantom candelabra in the Demi-Human forest.

markers.name: Tombsward Cave
markers.desc: A cave in Tombsward on the western Weeping Peninsula. Within is Miranda the Blighted Bloom.

markers.name: Stillwater Cave
markers.desc: A poison cave at the southernmost point of Liurnia Lake. At the end of the cave is a Cleanrot Knight.

markers.name: Lakeside Crystal Cave
markers.desc: A cave west of the Laskyar Ruins in Liurnia. A Bloodhound Knight blocks the way to the Slumbering Wolf's Shack where Latenna the Albinauric resides.

markers.name: Academy Crystal Cave
markers.desc: A cave on the western edge of the isle on which the Academy of Raya Lucaria stands, in the Crystalline Woods. A duo of Crystalians wait at the end.

markers.name: Sage's Cave
markers.desc: A cave to the west of the ruins of Wyndham on the Altus Plateau. Two foes lie within: a Black Knife Assassin, and the Necromancer Garris.

markers.name: Perfumer's Grotto
markers.desc: A cave system to the north of the grand staircase leading to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree on the ALtus Plateau, nestled between the stairs and the cliffs to the north. A Miranda Bloom and an Omenkiller reside within.

markers.name: Seethewater Cave
markers.desc: A cave on the Seethewater River on Mt. Gelmir, sealed behind an imp statue. At the end is a duo of Kindred of Rot

markers.name: Volcano Cave
markers.desc: A cave settled by Demi-Humans at the end of the road to the northeast of the ninth Mt. Gelmir campsite. Defending the cave is Demi-Human Queen Margot.

markers.name: Sellia Hideaway
markers.desc: A hidden cave behind an illusory wall in Caelid. The wall is found just north of a large tombstone in the nearby graveyard. This cave is part of Sorceress Sellen's questline, and has a trio of Crytalians within.

markers.name: Abandoned Cave
markers.desc: A cave found across a withered limb bridging the canyon in northern Caelid. A duo of Cleanrot Knights is found at the end.

markers.name: Gaol Cave
markers.desc: A cave system under Fort Gael that has been converted to a prison. It is locked behind an imp statue, and a Frenzied Duelist is encountered at the end.

markers.name: Dragonbarrow Cave
markers.desc: A cave in northern Dragonbarrow found by taking the northernmost road at the Dragonbarrow Fork. A Beastman of Farum Azula waits at the end.

markers.name: Spiritcaller Cave
markers.desc: A cave on the western coast of the Freezing Lake on the Mountaintops of the Giants. It is sealed by an imp statue and a Spiritcaller Snail defends the end of the cave.

markers.name: Cave of the Forlorn
markers.desc: A cave at the eastern end of the frozen river through the Consecrated Snowfield. It is sealed by an imp statue. The Misbegotten Crusader guards a legendary weapon at the end.

markers.name: Limgrave Tunnels
markers.desc: A smithing stone mining gallery to the north of Lake Agheel. The Stonedigger Troll lies at the end.

markers.name: Morne Tunnel
markers.desc: A mineshaft on the southern Weeping Peninsula teeming with Misbegotten and the boss, the Scaly Misbegotten.

markers.name: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
markers.desc: A crystal mining gallery to the northwest of the academy of Raya Lucaria. Miners here harvest crystal. A Crystalian is encountered at the end.

markers.name: Ruin-Strewn Precipice
markers.desc: Beginning with a crystal mining gallery, this series of ruins leads from the Ravine in Liurnia all the way up to the Altus Plateau. The way is guarded by Magma Wyrm Makar.

markers.name: Old Altus Tunnel
markers.desc: A smithing stone mining tunnel locked by an imp statue. At the end is a Stonedigger Troll more powerful than that in the Limgrave Tunnels.

markers.name: Altus Tunnel
markers.desc: A crystal tunnel in the southern Bower of Bounty. The tunnels are interlinked with the Perfumer's Grotto to the south. A duo of Crystalians guards the end.

markers.name: Sealed Tunnel
markers.desc: A smithing stone tunnel in the southern outskirts of Leyndell. The tunnel leads to the Divine Tower of West ALtus, but is guarded by an Onyx Lord.

markers.name: Gael Tunnel
markers.desc: A mineshaft north of Fort Gael in Caelid. It connects to an exit at the southeastern coast of Limgrave, with a gate that can only be opened from the Caelid side. A Magma Wyrm dwells within.

markers.name: Sellia Crystal Tunnel
markers.desc: A crystal tunnel northwest of Sellia, also accessed via the trapped chest in the Dragon-Burnt Ruins at Lake Agheel. One can only leave by finding the Site of Grace or facing the Fallingstar Beast.

markers.name: Yelough Anix Tunnel
markers.desc: A frozen gallery below the Yelough Anix Ruins on the western edge of the Consecrated Snowfield. A malformed star, Astel, dwells within.

markers.name: Divine Tower of Limgrave
markers.desc: Limgrave's divine tower allows the activation of Godrick's Great Rune. It is accessed via reaching the tower bridge entrance in Stormveil Castle, then taking a sending gate to cross the section of the divine bridge that is missing.
markers.image: File:Divine Tower of Limgrave - MENU Load 00005 PS5.png

markers.name: Carian Study Hall
markers.desc: A library in eastern Liurnia connected to the region's divine tower bridge. It is defended by Preceptor Miriam. The hall can also be inverted using an item from Ranni's questline.

markers.name: Divine Tower of Liurnia
markers.desc: Liurnia's divine tower is reached by ascending the Carian Study Hall, only possible with the inverted statue. No Great Rune is activated here, but the location is part of Ranni's questline.

markers.name: Divine Tower of West Altus
markers.desc: The westernmost of Altus Plateau's two divine towers, accessed via the Sealed Tunnel. Allows the activation of Rykard's Great Rune.
markers.image: File:ER Divine Tower of West Altus.png

markers.name: Divine Tower of East Altus
markers.desc: The easternmost of Altus Plateau's two divine towers, connected to Leyndell by a bridge guarded by the Fell Twins. Allows the activation of Morgott's and Mohg's Great Runes.
markers.image: File:ER Divine Tower of East Altus.png

markers.name: Divine Tower of Caelid
markers.desc: Caelid's divine tower can only be accessed by climbing onto the tree root and then along the engravings of the exterior walls. Allows the activation of Radahn's Great Rune.

markers.name: Isolated Divine Tower
markers.desc: The Isolated Divine Tower can be found by taking the sending gate from the Divine Bridge in Leyndell above the Fortified Manor. The bridge itself can be accessed via a trapped chest at the Tower of Return in Limgrave. Allows the activation of Malenia's Great Rune.

markers.name: Church of Elleh
markers.desc: Located north of the The First Step site of grace. It is inhabited by the Nomadic Merchant Kalé, and contains a Smithing Table which allows the player to strenghten their armaments.

markers.name: Furnace Golem (Charo's Hidden Grave)
markers.desc:
Is protected by iron leg-guards, conventional attacks will have no effect.

Drops the Glovewort Crystal Tear.

markers.name: Furnace Golem (Church District Highroad)
markers.desc:
Is protected by iron leg-guards, conventional attacks will have no effect.

Drops the Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear.

markers.name: Furnace Golem (Ruins of Unte)
markers.desc:
Found dormant while blocking the entrance to the Ruins of Unte. 
Requires the Player to reignite it with a Hefty Furnace Pot before they can proceed into the ruins.
Will stay awoken after area-reload.

Drops the Bloodsucking Cracked Tear.

markers.name: Furnace Golem (Castle Watering Hole)
markers.desc:
Found dormant, half-buried in the riverbed.
Will wake on approach and will return to dormancy on area-reload. Once awoken, the same pot throwing locations found in the Ruins of Unte will suffice. Drops the Oil-Soaked Tear.

markers.name: Furnace Golem (Rauh Ancient Ruins)
markers.desc:
Found dormant in the floor. Will wake on the player's approach from the ruined bridge norhteast of its location.

Drops the Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Three-Path Cross)
markers.desc:
On the cliffs southwest of Pillar Path Waypoint.

Requires one to shoot the Golem with a long-ranged weapon to gain its attention and lure it closer to the cliffs.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Three-Path Cross)
markers.desc:
On the roofs of the northeastern-most building (where the Blade of Mercy can be found within).

While it's possible to lure and throw pots into the Golem from here, it is generally extremely inefficient as the Golem will constantly try to teleport back to its patrolling location.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Ellac River Downstream)
markers.desc:
From the northern cliffs of Charo's Hidden Grave. Requires the golem to patrol further up the river before being in range of Hefty Pot throws. 

Despite the player being extremely high up by comparison, the golem will eventually notice them and aggro when it's somewhat within range.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Charo's Hidden Grave)
markers.desc: On the cliffs up a Spiritspring near the Golem itself.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Church District Highroad)
markers.desc: On a small set of cliffs, up a Spiritspring, directly west of the Golem.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Ruins of Unte - Single Use)
markers.desc:
On the balcony of a ruined building found directly north of the dormant Furnace Golem.

Requires the Player to throw a single Hefty Furnace Pot into the basket of the dormant golem in order to re-ignite it so it can move out of the way. Once it does, this location becomes irrelevant.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Ruins of Unte)
markers.desc: On the roof of the entrance archway.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Ruins of Unte)
markers.desc: At the top of the spiral-patterned tower.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Scadu Altus)
markers.desc: On the cliffs west of the Furnace Golem's patrol route. Requires the golem to have already moved to its station on the southern edges of the camp before being lured to the cliffs with a ranged weapon.

markers.name: Furnace Golem (Scadu Altus)
markers.desc: On the cliffs guarded by Perfumers east of the campsite. If the golem has moved to its station on the southern edge of the campsite then a ranged weapon is required to lure it closer to the cliffs.

markers.name: Pot Throwing Location (Rauh Ancient Ruins)
markers.desc: On the cliffs west of the Furnace Golem. Can be easily accessed from the bottom by a Sealed Spiritspring, once it has been unsealed.
